controls.qualification: A sphere of the published radius, lit by HD 97658; the neutral gray is a display convention, not a measured colour.
controls.notes: No image or colour of HD 97658 b is published: the sphere has its measured size, and the gray marks an unresolved surface. The lighting is its own star's, at the measured orbit. The gray takes the colour of hd-97658's light, as its colour dataset measures it.

charts.alt: The orbits of HD 97658's planets in this map from above, to scale, with HD 97658 b highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.

HD 97658 b's transmission spectrum: the fraction of starlight the planet blocks as it crosses its star, larger where its atmosphere absorbs. 28 measured bins from Knutson et al. 2014 (Hubble Space Telescope satellite, Wide Field Camera 3), as the NASA Exoplanet Archive lists them. Horizontal bars are wavelength bins; vertical bars are the published 1-sigma errors.

HD 97658 b crossing its star, as TESS recorded it: 2 sectors (22, 49) of the SPOC pipeline's 2-minute light curves of TIC 82308728, each transit divided by a straight line fitted to the light either side and folded onto the orbit the app draws, then averaged in 11-minute bins. Error bars are each bin's standard error.
